purpose: Challenge bracket-only relative traversal over a focused finite L1 carrier while keeping production RELATIVE raw and leaving result/inverse semantics unaccepted.

contextUnderChallenge.graph: finite accepted L1 Link carrier with cycles/sharing allowed

resultModels.name: selected-node-only
resultModels.strength: minimal forward observation relative to an explicit context
resultModels.problem: multiple finite paths can select the same node, so selected node alone cannot reconstruct source path

resultModels.name: selected-node-plus-path-provenance
resultModels.strength: replay/source preservation without requiring a graph search
resultModels.problem: must decide whether path is semantic denotation data or non-semantic provenance before defining equality/inverse

resultModels.name: selected-rooted-subcarrier
resultModels.reason: a cyclic/shared rooted subcarrier can include the whole reachable graph and does not by itself solve path identity/inverse ambiguity

explicitlyUnresolved: whether selected node alone is the relative denotation
whether traversal path is semantic or provenance
canonical inverse when multiple paths select the same node
relative equality between contexts or selected nodes
negativeVetoes: do not import root 0/1 aliases into relative context
do not apply root-opening-collapse to relative traversal
do not treat quote envelope removal as relative traversal
do not use L2 parent context as structural start/end navigation
do not compare raw integer node indices as cross-language identity
do not use persistent LinkRef/physical address
do not materialize or mutate L4
do not choose a shortest/lexicographic inverse path implicitly
requiredProperties: [[ and ]] compose exactly two role steps
finite paths terminate on cyclic carriers without unfolding cycles
isomorphic symbolic carriers with different local node indices have identical normalized observations
distinct raw paths may select one node without becoming the same raw carrier
0/1 and mixed carriers are typed unresolved in this subset
root and quote behavior remain unchanged

inverseFindingGate.reason: challenge deliberately distinguishes forward selection, source-path provenance and canonical inverse

releaseGate: portable challenge passes on at least two index assignments of the same symbolic cyclic/shared carrier
decide whether path is semantic or provenance
define inverse domain or explicit undefined result
publish accepted relative-denotation contract before changing production RELATIVE
